about: EDM tracks the site is allowed to host and serve: each is licensed Creative Commons (CC BY, CC BY-SA) by its artist or label, so the credit in each song's attribution must be shown, and `source` is the page where the licence was verified. Each plays from /music/<id>.m4a (R2 bucket airdeck-music; local copies in public-music/, gitignored; upload with `npm run upload-music`). bpm starts as an estimate and is replaced by the measured tempo; beat is measured by `node scripts/analyze-library.mjs --public`. Only add audio the owner has the right to publish (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, own, or permission); never NC, ND, or custom 'free for video' licences.
